mapper.select: select c.id as cart_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, p.name, p.price, p.image_url from cart c join product p on c.product_id = p.id where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.id
mapper.insert: insert into cart(user_id, product_id, quantity) values (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity})
mapper.delete: delete from cart where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId}
